Question:
An operations numeric-terminal capture contains two unfinished evaluation reservations at time T. Both later settle and are privately disposed. A focused resources query is made, followed by an aggregate snapshot query. What values, revision and capture time should those queries report, and what can a caller conclude about physical resources?
